scenes.background_prompt: A modern startup office breakroom. Clean, minimalist, beanbag chairs. A poster says 'DISRUPT'.

dialogue.line: Bro, I'm telling you, our new app is going to revolutionize the way people breathe. It's called 'Oxy+', a SaaS platform for actual air. We're disrupting the atmosphere.
dialogue.visual_prompt: Chad leans against the espresso machine, holding a mason jar of green liquid. He looks very smug.

dialogue.line: Chad, that's just a subscription service for not suffocating. Isn't that technically extortion? You've paywalled the troposphere.
dialogue.visual_prompt: Greg rubs his temples, staring at his laptop with dark circles under his eyes.

dialogue.line: Words like 'extortion' are for people who don't understand freemium models. Everyone gets the first 100 breaths free. After that, it's just $9.99 a month for Premium Oxygen.
dialogue.visual_prompt: Chad gestures enthusiastically, drawing an imaginary graph in the air.

dialogue.line: People breathe twenty thousand times a day, Chad. They'll run out of free breaths in ten minutes.
Exactly! High conversion rate. We monetize the biological necessity.
dialogue.visual_prompt: Chad points finger guns at Greg, winking.

scenes.background_prompt: A busy city street. A mix of wealthy people and struggling people.

dialogue.line: Tired of breathing poor-people air? Upgrade to Oxy+ Elite! Now with hints of lavender and exclusivity!
dialogue.visual_prompt: A slick businessman takes a deep breath with a glowing 'Oxy+' halo around his head.

dialogue.line: Can... can you spare a breath?
dialogue.visual_prompt: A man turning slightly blue reaches out.

dialogue.line: Sorry, I only have Apple Pay.
dialogue.visual_prompt: The businessman taps his smartwatch and walks away briskly.

scenes.background_prompt: Back in the modern startup office breakroom.

dialogue.line: We're literally suffocating the poor. My mother tells her friends I'm dead.
dialogue.visual_prompt: Greg has his head in his hands on the table.

dialogue.line: She's just mourning the un-optimized you. We're gamifying survival! Plus, our AI algorithm predicts the lower classes will evolve gills within three generations anyway. We're accelerating human evolution!
dialogue.visual_prompt: Chad takes another sip of his green liquid, completely unbothered.

dialogue.line: Gills don't work on land! We live in Denver! Do you hear yourself? I spent six years at MIT, Chad, and now I'm actively committing crimes against humanity.
dialogue.visual_prompt: Greg stands up, knocking his chair backwards in frustration.

dialogue.line: Bad press is just good press in a trench coat, Greg. You just need to reframe this. If they want to keep enjoying oxygen, they just need to watch two unskippable ads for our sponsor, Raid Shadow Legends.
dialogue.visual_prompt: Chad pulls out his phone to check his crypto portfolio.

dialogue.line: We are the villains in a dystopian YA novel! I can't do this anymore. I'm deleting the source code.
dialogue.visual_prompt: Greg frantically types on his laptop.

dialogue.line: Whoa, chill out man! Take a deep breath! ... Oh, wait.
dialogue.visual_prompt: Chad looks at his phone and taps a button with a sinister smile.

scenes.background_prompt: The startup breakroom. Greg is clutching his throat.

dialogue.visual_prompt: Greg turns blue, grasping at his neck.

dialogue.line: You forgot to renew your employee discount, Greg. Your account has been suspended for violating our Terms of Service.
dialogue.visual_prompt: Chad stands over him, totally apathetic.
Greg collapses onto the beanbag chair, out cold.

dialogue.line: Don't worry, man. Just watch this 30-second ad for DraftKings and you'll get a 5 percent oxygen boost.
dialogue.visual_prompt: Chad holds his phone in front of Greg's unconscious face.

dialogue.line: Engagement is through the roof today.
dialogue.visual_prompt: Chad turns to the camera, gives a thumbs up, and takes a final loud slurp of his green drink.
